dz: 罗纳德·里根被选为第40任美国总统,击败了现任的吉米·卡特.
de: Ronald Reagan is elected as the 40th President of the United States, defeating incumbent Jimmy Carter.

dz: 路易斯安那州皮涅尔湖排入了地下盐矿. 在钻石晶体盐矿中钻入了一枚错位的德克萨科石油探测器,使水流入矿中,侵蚀了洞的边缘.
de: Lake Peigneur in Louisiana drains into an underlying salt deposit. A misplaced Texaco oil probe had been drilled into the Diamond Crystal Salt Mine, causing water to flow down into the mine, eroding the edges of the hole.

dz: 内华达州天堂的米高梅大酒店(现为巴利的拉斯维加斯)发生致命起火. 内华达州历史上最严重的灾难有85人丧生,650多人受伤.
de: A deadly fire breaks out at the MGM Grand Hotel in Paradise, Nevada (now Bally's Las Vegas). Eighty-five people are killed and more than 650 are injured in the worst disaster in Nevada history.

dz: 目击者报告说,在英国萨福克州伦德勒斯姆森林(Rendlesham Forest)的RAF Woodbridge附近,发生了几起不明灯光的目击事件,其中第一起是被称作"Britain's Roswell"的事件.
de: Witnesses report the first of several sightings of unexplained lights near RAF Woodbridge, in Rendlesham Forest, Suffolk, England, United Kingdom, an incident called "Britain's Roswell".
